statement: Week brought a new mechanic and a major time gate hours after release.
Many bug fixes came through including reversion of marble and crystal bugs.
Crystals remain in the gutter after the two-fold nerf; better than the earlier three-fold nerf.
Artifact gain this week can be good for those who are behind.
Essence gain this week isn't awful.
Consider two-hour claims on your characters for maximum chances to pull key artifacts.
Crystal merit week was shadow nerfed from 40x to just 6x at 400% multi.
Merit nerf plus daily crystal nerf killed the meta zenith cluster farming strategy and left those who missed last crystal merit behind.
Merit at maximum power only brings crystal rates back to pre-nerf normal off-merit rates.
Kilroy appears to be the merit next week; don't run Kilroy this week so reset lands midway through next week.
With reset midway through next week you can double dip for up to 12 runs using gems.
If reset is near end of week use silver stopwatches to pull third week into merit for up to 18 runs.
Kilroy is fantastic for restoring candy stores allowing multiple tens of thousands of candies.
Plump database is a notable exotic market offering that increases land rank database.
Land rank database includes the final column which contributes to the rest of account and has healthy drop rate.
Plump database returns next week so don't worry if you can't push it over the next 7 days.
Legumes 2 has a strong boost to beans and is fully worth getting into the 4K plus range.
Stable root sits solidly in the middle of the pack under legumes and plump database.
Land rank EXP is important and stable root is a great source of it.
Prisma bubble bonus stacks with pallet.
Four-leaf clover boosts pallet luck
Bountiful crows is just ahead of the dog water crops; additive with other plus one crop sources.
Plus one crop is a base value multiplied by everything else; day market gives most of the gains early.
Bountiful crows still worth a few clicks.
Better day two is nearly worthless as most of day market isn't good and reduction is weak.
Curtain hemlock is impotent and added to a very weak kill per kill bucket; you won't notice it.
These two are dead last and aren't worth your time.
Wind walker pack is star of the week with best in slot 2X true multi attire and AFK gain name tag.
If you want to get ahead on class EXP this is one of the biggest sources in the game.
Timeless pack is power crept out of relevancy.
Cape's main use is looking nice and giving plus one slab.
Name tag for 1.4X damage is no longer the meta damage bucket; bigger damage is.
Greatest strength is the second worst pack in the game.
Not going to enter is back and it's a fantastic week to run miscellaneous.
Miscellaneous run nets nine trophies and 0% class XP but 15% bonus damage.
These weeks don't come often so take advantage.
Extra weekly boss damage comes from crab cake kills mining level and cooking level.

Conductive software is a mainstay of many chip setups boosting AFK gains rate.
Conductive nanochip isn't bad for live gains.
Drill spinner has the sapphire amulet which is a tidy boost for all stat.
Rare powerful chips are coming in the next 2 weeks; prep for them now.
Poker chip is up next week costing 2 million PVC pipes plus 100 soda and nebulon mantle spice.
Nebulon mantle spice needs pushing in breeding if you're just starting.
Chocolate chip is the week after; prep 200k pinion spurs and cheese and beach dog spice.
Chocolate chip will not return for weeks if not months.
Chocolate chip is a meta-defining chip enabling otherwise impossible active farming and is the most important focus if you lack it.
A patch in a little over a week brings quality of life changes and new divinity and coral kit mechanics.
Get your second AC if not both ACs and stack hours on divinity and lab if goat divinity is unlocked.
